VR-124059
 Project Description: 
Our customer is a market leader which fulfills development, production and integration of high-performance Infotainment systems and Telematics control units for the Automotive industry (Tier-1 supplier for car manufacturers).
 Responsibilities: 
 • Performs software validation for one or more projects on new Infotainment system and Telematics Control Unit (Wi-Fi/ BT Connectivity, Internet Connectivity, Hands free phone, ECall, Telematics Applications, NAD, Vehicle Network, 4G/5G Connectivity) on test benches and test vehicles.
 • Applies specifications, user guides, use cases, comparable products, and previous known bugs to create and maintain test suites and test cases.
 • Performs manual and automated software testing. Performs session-based exploratory testing.
 • Identifies software issues and transfers problem issues into the issue tracking system with supporting log files and data.
 • Verifies the fixes for the software issues.
 • Records, processes, and analyzes data with PC based tools and test instrumentation.
 • Documents testing and creates test reports.
 • Coordinates with different departments domestically and internationally
 • Participates in requirements reviews, design reviews, and other activities in the framework of an Agile/Scrum development process.
 • Provides technical support for the resolution of various customer and interdepartmental issues on an as needed basis.
 • English very good (spoken and written).
 Mandatory Skills Description: 
 • Bachelor's degree in Automation, Electronics, Energy Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
 • A minimum of 6 months of experience in a technical or engineering role.
 • Experience with creating and executing test cases
 • Working knowledge of functional and non-functional software testing, the software test life cycle, and various test design methodologies
 • Bug tracking tools
 • Test management tools
 • Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, versioning systems (or equivalent tools).
 • Working knowledge of computer hardware and networking.
 • At least one year in a product engineering or test engineering role in an embedded environment, preferably in automotive or telecom.
 • Good soft skills in team communication.
 • Proven experience in testing different Telematics domains like: NAD, eSIM, eCall, OTA, GNSS, Positioning, 4G/5G Connectivity, BT/BLE, WiFi, Vehicle Networking (CAN, Ethernet), Diagnosis, Networking.
 • Strong attention to details.
 • Exemplary verbal and written communication skills (English).
 • Creative problem-solver capable of creating and reproducing interesting software bugs.
 • Driving license category B
 Nice-to-Have Skills Description: 
Vehicle networking experience (CAN, MOST).
ISTQB Foundation Level certification or equivalent
